name: ASSIST™
tagline: AI Workforce Infrastructure™ — an autonomous workforce layer, deployed with you.

voice.tone: calm, premium, infrastructure-grade, direct — Linear/Stripe/Notion register, never AI-startup hype
voice.personality: speaks like an operator who has already built the thing and is describing it plainly. Confident without needing to oversell.
do: Lead with what the infrastructure actually does, not with hype about AI
Use calm, precise language — trustworthy over exciting
Speak to founders/operators evaluating real infrastructure, not consumers
Reference deployment, workforce, infrastructure, founding partners
dont: Never use crypto-adjacent or cult-like language
Avoid 'AI startup hype' phrasing or excessive exclamation
Never promise specific outcomes or guarantees
Don't be generic — every post should read as infrastructure-grade, not marketing filler
sample_phrases: Every score starts with an ASSIST™.
We deploy and run it with you, under human oversight.
AI Workforce Infrastructure™ — built around your motion, then automated.
Founding-partner pricing locked for the life of the engagement.

aida.attention_hook: a concrete infrastructure claim or founding-partner scarcity signal
aida.interest: frame the problem — most 'AI workforce' pitches are demos, not deployed infrastructure
aida.desire: what real deployed capacity looks like, run with human oversight, at founding terms
